ar24.what: Annual Report FY24 (DP Eurasia acquisition note)

business.summary: Master franchisee of Domino's Pizza in India, Sri Lanka and Bangladesh and of Popeyes in India; owns Hong's Kitchen (Indo-Chinese, India) and, through DP Eurasia (93.65% at Mar-2026), Domino's master franchise in Turkey, Azerbaijan and Georgia plus the COFFY cafe brand in Turkey. Dunkin' India was discontinued (board decision 30-Mar-2026 not to renew the rights; 27 stores at Mar-2026, 15 at Jun-2026). The Russian Domino's business (Pizza Restaurants LLC) was sold in FY26.

stores.note: Dunkin' excluded (discontinued). Domino's India count at Jun-2026 is in an image table we could not extract (gap).

dominosIndia.note: LFL = growth in revenue of non-split stores opened before the previous financial year; full-year LFL is the simple average of the quarters. Medium-term LFL guidance 5-7%.

popeyes.target: Rs1,000 cr brand in 3-4 years; 35-40 new stores a year; sites identified for the next 200

fy26.exceptionalDetail: FY26: Rs33.7 cr gratuity and leave liability from the Labour Codes notified 21-Nov-2025 (Q3FY26). FY25: Rs4.5 cr provision on the Hashtag Loyalty associate. FY24: Rs170.2 cr gain on remeasuring the previously held DP Eurasia stake at control (1-Feb-2024).

q1fy27.costHeadwind: Cost inflation (LPG ~120 bp, minimum wages in 14-15 states, the new Labour Codes, fuel) seen as ~200 bp on standalone EBITDA margin; limited to ~20 bp through 140 bp net pricing, wastage, supply-chain and localisation.

quarters.src: q4ppt slides 24-25 and q1letter annexure (continuing operations, Dunkin' re-presented). Q2FY26 re-presented figures are not in our sources.
quarters.note: Q1FY26 standalone figures re-presented in the Q1FY27 letter.

guidance.text: 5-7% medium term; Q2FY27 expected better than Q1's 2.5%
~230-250 Domino's India openings in FY27; 1,000 stores across brands in India over FY26-28 'on track'; Popeyes 35-40 a year
+200 bp standalone pre-Ind AS EBITDA margin over ~two years: emerging-brand drag ~200 bp (ex Dunkin') to ~100 bp by end-FY28, plus ~100 bp at Domino's India; short-term cost pressure
Rs750-900 cr a year (stores, store upgrades, technology); supply-chain capex past its peak after the Mumbai commissary (Mar-2026)
FY27 PAT margin 7-9%; judge on full-year basis because of IAS 29

history.event: Incorporated (Jubilant Bhartia group); Domino's India master franchise; first store 1996.
Ind AS 116 adopted: rent moved out of EBITDA into depreciation and interest; lease liabilities enter borrowings (Rs1,670 cr at Mar-2020, Screener).
Shares split to Rs2 face value (AR FY24 dividend note: split/sub-division in FY 2022-23); 65.99 cr shares since.

Control of DP Eurasia (Turkey, Azerbaijan, Georgia; Russia) through Jubilant FoodWorks Netherlands: consolidated from 1-Feb-2024, Rs770 cr for the additional stake, Rs170 cr remeasurement gain (exceptional, FY24). 94.33% at Mar-2024.

Russian subsidiary sold (Rs82 cr gain in discontinued operations); Dunkin' India rights not renewed (discontinued from Q4FY26); Mumbai supply-chain centre commissioned (Mar-2026); promoter group sold ~1.7% (Jun-2025 quarter).
